Kaam ki Table + Istri + Locker: Final Design

Sheesham lakri, brass handle. Yeh table 5 hisson mein alag ho jaati hai, koi auzaar (tool) nahi chahiye. Saare naap inch mein hain, bracket mein cm.

Yeh table kis kaam ki hai?

  • Computer ka kaam: laptop, keyboard aur mouse top par. Lambe ghanton tak aaram se baith kar kaam.
  • Istri (iron): khare ho kar top par istri, poori table par garmi se bachne wali chadar bichha kar.
  • Kapre aur saman: dono taraf cabinet. Har cabinet mein upar 1 daraz aur neeche 1 bara locker (andar 2 shelf).
  • Portable: 5 hissay alag ho jate hain: top, 2 cabinet, back panel, footrest.

3D design aur rang

Rang abhi final nahi. Neeche table ko ghumayein, rang aur lakri badlein, "Top uthao" ya "Sab alag karo" dabayein. Is page ki baqi tasveerein aur video abhi sheesham + brass mein hain; rang final hone ke baad us rang mein dobara banengi.
Ungli / mouse se ghumayein, do ungliyon se zoom
Table ka rang chunein

Har hissay ka rang alag chun sakte hain. Table foran badal jayegi.

Tayyar combinations
Meri salah, number 1 se 3: top aur frame lakri ke rakhein (mazboot, istri aur kharoonch ke liye behtar), darwaze aur panel halke cream ya ivory. Is se table halki aur khoobsurat lagti hai, magar bed jaisi bhaari nahi. Poora cream ya golden kaam ki table par jaldi ganda hota hai.

Aap ka chuna hua rang

Screen par rang asal se thora mukhtalif dikhta hai. Final karne se pehle carpenter se lakri aur polish ka asal sample zaroor dekhein.

  • Keyboard aur mouse top par rahenge, desk mat ke upar. Neeche nikalne wali tray (slide) nahi: woh 22" se zyada chauri nahi ban sakti (keyboard + mouse ko 27" chahiye), ghutnon se takrati hai aur typing mein hilti hai.

  • Istri: poori table par garmi se bachne wali moti chadar (ironing cover / blanket). Is se poora top mehfooz rehta hai.

Har hissa kya hai aur kya karta hai

1. Top aur uski pins

Har cabinet ke upar 4 chhoti lakri ki pins (dowel) hain, kul 8. Top ke neeche 8 steel ke sleeve (chhoti steel ki nali) lage hain. Top neeche rakho to pins sleeve mein baith jati hain.

Pins sirf top ko sarakne se rokti hain. Wazan poore cabinet par aata hai. Pin steel mein jati hai, is liye surakh kabhi kharab nahi hota.

2. Cable holes (top par 2 gol nishan)

Top mein 2 gol surakh (2.4" / 6 cm), jin mein grommet laga hota hai: plastic ya metal ka chhalla jis ka flip lid wala dhakkan ho. Keyboard, charger aur laptop ki taarein in se neeche jati hain. Taar na ho to dhakkan band: dhool aur chhoti cheezein neeche nahi girtin, aur surakh ka kinara kharab nahi hota.

3. Cable tray (top ke neeche lambi tray)

Top ke neeche lakri ka seedha khula dabba: dono cabinets ke beech poori lambai (23 1/2"), aage-peeche 8" (20 cm), andar 4" (10 cm) uncha. Aage ka kinara sirf 1 5/8" (4 cm) uncha hai, baqi khula, taake charger aur extension board aage se aasani se andar daal sakein. Dabba ghutnon ke peeche khatam hota hai, is liye baithte waqt ghutne nahi lagte. Is mein extension board (power strip), chargers aur faltu taarein rehti hain: zameen se upar aur nazar se chhupi hui. Upar se khuli hai taake charger ki garmi nikal jaye. Top uthao to tray bhi saath uth jati hai.

4. Back panel (dono cabinets ke beech peeche)

Yeh table ko mazboot banata hai: istri ya typing karte waqt table daayein baayein nahi hilti. Dono cabinets ke saath palang wale hook (bed fitting) se lagta hai: upar se daalo, neeche baith jata hai. Hook peeche ki taraf hain, saamne se nazar nahi aate.

5. Footrest (pairon ka takhta)

Alag se zameen par khara hota hai, dono cabinets ki taangon ke beech fit. Pairon ka wazan seedha zameen par jata hai. Takhta 3 unchaiyon par lag sakta hai (peg badal kar), halka sa jhuka hua taake ghanton baithne mein aaram rahe. Safai ke liye bahar nikal sakte hain.

6. Cabinet (dono ek jaise)

4 solid sheesham ki taangein aur rail ka frame. Frame ke andar plywood ke panel, bahar se 8 mm (5/16") andar, taake saaf line nazar aaye. Upar daraz, neeche bara locker darwaza, andar 2 shelf.

Jorna aur kholna

Jorna (4 steps, koi tool nahi)

  1. Dono cabinet rakhein, beech mein 24" (61 cm) faasla.
  2. Back panel ko peeche se dono cabinets ke hooks mein upar se daal kar neeche bitha dein.
  3. Footrest ko beech mein rakh dein.
  4. Top ko upar rakhein: 8 pins steel sleeves mein baith jayein.

Kholna

Yehi steps ulte: top uthao, footrest nikalo, back panel upar utha kar nikalo, cabinet alag karo.

Kaise istemal karein

  • Kaam karte waqt: kursi ko taqreeban 24.5" (62 cm) par rakhein, taake baazu seedhe top par rahein. Pair footrest par. Footrest ki unchai is hisaab se set karein ke ghutne aaram se mur jayein.
  • Istri: poori table par heat-proof chadar bichha kar khare ho kar istri karein.
  • Laptop: stand par peeche, keyboard aur mouse aage desk mat par. Baazu top par aaram se.

Carpenter ke liye zaroori hidayat

  1. Lakri: taangein aur rail solid sheesham. Panel 3/4" (18 mm) achi plywood par sheesham veneer. Chipboard bilkul nahi.
  2. Frame ke jor: taang aur rail mortise-tenon (chool) + glue. Yeh pakke jor hain, kabhi nahi khulenge.
  3. Jo jor khulte hain: sirf metal mein metal (pin steel sleeve mein, hook bed fitting mein). Lakri mein seedha screw nahi, jo baar baar khule.
  4. Panel: frame ki groove mein, bahar ki satah se 8 mm (5/16") andar. Koi khula gap nahi hona chahiye.
  5. Top ka aage wala kinara gol (round) karein, taake baazu ko chubhe nahi.
  6. Polish: sheesham ka natural / medium brown rang. Top par PU (polyurethane) polish, jo garmi aur paani se kharab na ho (istri ki wajah se).
  7. Neeche ke kinare seal karein (pochay ke paani se bachane ke liye) aur neeche levelling feet lagayein.
  8. Test: deliver karne se pehle pura jor kar check karein: top bilkul na hile, daraz aur darwaze aaram se chalein, pins asaani se sleeve mein jayein.
  9. Hooks back panel ke peeche ki taraf lagayein, saamne se nazar na aayein.
